title: Event secrecy: no body bytes or PII reach the sink under a mutation-run
asA: operator running the event-secrecy probe on a PII fixture
iWant: the probe to prove zero body / PII / user id substring leaves the facade via the sink under both the shipped code path and a mutation-run
soThat: the estate can trust the facade never leaks the body to the log stream even when a downstream change tries to

acceptanceCriteria.description: The event-secrecy probe puts, gets and deletes a PII fixture (key users/1234/profile, body containing REDACTED-fixture SSN); every event record on the sink carries only the whitelist and no substring of the SSN, no substring of the user id beyond the key itself, and no substring of the body. A mutation-run turning on SIMULATE_PII_LEAK flips the probe to fail with the leaked field named.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade wired to a spy sink with a PII fixture
acceptanceCriteria.when: put/get/delete operations run on the PII key with the mutation-run switch off then on
acceptanceCriteria.then: the recorded events contain only the whitelist; PII-substring scan returns zero hits; the mutation-run under SIMULATE_PII_LEAK trips the probe to fail

acceptanceCriteria.description: Metadata blob is never a body: facade.put(k, v, {metadata:{v:1, body:"REDACTED-fixture"}}) still emits a kvWrite record carrying only the whitelist keys (event, key, size, ttl, timestamp); the metadata blob's body substring does not appear in any emitted record. The whitelist scan returns zero hits for "REDACTED-fixture".
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade.put call with a metadata blob carrying a body substring
acceptanceCriteria.then: the record has only the whitelist keys and no substring of the metadata body

acceptanceCriteria.description: Substring scan across all record kinds: the layer-2 substring scan on the sink accumulator runs against every record kind (facadeReady, kvHit, kvMiss, kvWrite) and asserts zero hits for the PII fixture substrings (SSN, user id numeric). No record kind is exempted.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade driven with the PII fixture on the shipped path
acceptanceCriteria.when: the layer-2 substring scan runs across every emitted record
acceptanceCriteria.then: zero PII substring hits are reported

acceptanceCriteria.description: Layer separation: the layer-1 whitelist scan and the layer-2 substring scan trip independently. A synthetic scenario that adds only a forbidden key (no PII substring) trips layer 1 alone; a scenario that leaks a PII substring inside an existing whitelisted field (e.g. a poisoned key) trips layer 2 alone. The probe reports which layer fired.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe runs on each scenario
acceptanceCriteria.then: the forbidden-key scenario fires layer 1 only; the substring scenario fires layer 2 only
